name: ship-kit
description: Claude Code skills for the card-to-merge loop AND for running tests locally: pick the next task off the board and branch for it, implement a feature to the project's conventions, generate tests, open a pull request, review a PR (lint + typecheck + deterministic convention audit + the code-review plugin), watch open PRs and surface only the actionable ones, triage the daily security-scan brief, and close the card out after merge. Also runs the tests ad hoc: unit, api (integration) and e2e suites with a one-page results summary, and UAT — acceptance criteria driven through a real browser as a user would, returning a per-criterion pass/fail/unclear verdict with evidence and screenshots. Browser runs are headless by default and always say so; --headed shows the window. Stack-agnostic — the deterministic checks self-skip on repos they don't apply to. Use for "what's next", "create a pr", "review this pr", "watch open prs", "write tests", "run the tests", "run uat", "card done".
